# Security Policy

Security fixes apply to the latest release and the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/deepdave98/latex-resume-template/security/advisories/new) instead of opening a public issue.

Include the affected file or release, steps to reproduce the issue, and its possible impact. I will acknowledge the report as soon as I can and keep you updated while I investigate.
